issue.title: Prevent stale comment snapshots from erasing concurrent suffix updates
issue.description: Research at sase 21c18cc34bda871773519abfb14982dec2826e87 independently reproduced a lost update through the real parser and set_comment_suffix on an isolated temporary ProjectSpec. Root cause: set_comment_suffix constructs an entire COMMENTS replacement from caller-supplied stale comments; update_patch_comments_field locks only the write. Zombie and workflow callers pass snapshot lists. Transform current state under the owner lock and preserve disjoint updates; cover stale caller lists and the analogous remove_comment_entry fast path. Keep shared domain semantics in Rust core or its existing owner API as required. This is bounded correctness work independent of lumberjack removal, not a scheduler redesign.

task_type_fields.impact: Concurrent hook-lane reconcilers can erase a running CRS marker or another comment update despite taking the ProjectSpec write lock. Production frequency and downstream duplicate launches were not measured.
task_type_fields.repro: Create a temporary Mailed Patch with Alice and Bob comment entries without suffixes. Parse it twice before writing. Call set_comment_suffix using snapshot A to give Alice a running_agent suffix. Call set_comment_suffix using stale snapshot B to give Bob a ZOMBIE error suffix. Reparse: Bob is ZOMBIE and Alice has no suffix; both writes returned True. Expected both suffixes to survive. This deterministic interleaving reproduced on 2026-09-15.
